name: When are light fixtures and outlet covers installed during the remodel?

mainEntity.name: When are light fixtures and outlet covers installed during the remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: Final electrical trim—installing decorative light fixtures, outlet plates, switches, and under-cabinet lighting—occurs after walls are painted and tile or cabinetry is installed. Coordinating this final stage ensures delicate fixtures and freshly painted trim aren't damaged. Because Abraham Becerra and his crew handle the painting, tile setting, and finish carpentry, we control the exact timing for the electrician to return and install finish devices cleanly.
acceptedAnswer.description: Final electrical trim occurs near the end of the project, after interior painting, tile installation, and cabinetry are completed.
